item.title: Symmetry- and Property-Aware Crystal Generation with Reinforcement Learning for Inverse Materials Design
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ting-Wei Hsu, Arun Bansil, Qimin Yan
SPARC将晶体对称性与目标物性共同纳入强化学习生成。研究表明，对称性不仅是约束，也是获得可实现功能性质的物理基础。

item.title: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) to predict vibrational stability of inorganic semiconductors
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该文聚焦用物理信息神经网络预测无机半导体振动稳定性。主题指向将物理约束引入材料稳定性机器学习评估。

item.title: Machine Learning Guided CALPHAD Design of Ru-Stabilized BCC B2 Refractory Alloys

item.title: Prescreening Point Defects in Semiconductors With Machine Learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Paul Karlsson, Joel Davidsson, Rickard Armiento
arXiv:2609.14846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput calculations using density-functional theory (DFT) are commonly used to explore point defects for applications in power electronics and quantum technologies. There is currently a major shift away from these traditional simulation techniques towards machine learning (ML) methods. We explore a class of physics-guided ML models for predicting defect formation energies and zero-phonon lines (ZPL) to identify point defects for quantum applications. The models are specifically targeted for use in a prescreening step for accelerated high-throughput workflows, and are therefore designed to avoid the costly relaxation step typically present with ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs). We compare performance for single and double point defe…

item.title: Bayesian neural networks versus deep ensembles for uncertainty quantification in machine learning interatomic potentials
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Riccardo Farris, Emanuele Telari, Nongnuch Artrith, Konstantin M Neyman, Albert Bruix
Neural-network-based machine learning interatomic potentials have emerged as powerful tools for predicting atomic energies and forces, enabling accurate and efficient simulations in atomistic modeling. A key limitation of traditional deep learning approaches, however, is their inability to provide reliable estimates of predictive uncertainty. Such uncertainty quantification is critical for assessing model reliability, especially in materials science, where often the model is applied on out-of-distribution data. Different strategies have been proposed to address this challenge, with deep ensembles (DE) and Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) being among the most widely used. In this work, we introduce an implementation of BNNs with variational inference in the ænet-PyTorch framework. To evalua…

item.title: Physics-Informed Neural Modeling of TiO 2 Photoanode Thickness-Dependent Electron Transport and Photovoltaic Performance in Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells
item.description:

item.title: PolyGraphPy: A unified Python framework for atomistic simulation and machine learning-driven polymer design
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect

item.title: 利用图神经网络自动为CO₂同位素体分配AFGL量子数
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Marco G. Barnfield, Sergei N. Yurchenko, Jonathan Tennyson
准确分配计算分子能级的量子数，是生成用于辐射传输应用的完整谱线表及其线展宽参数的关键瓶颈。本文建立了自动化流程，利用GraphSAGE图神经网络、同位素体间微扰链和同位素体内转动阶梯边，为12种稳定CO₂同位素体中低于15000 cm⁻¹的转振能级分配AFGL量子数。该流程还结合匈牙利算法进行物理唯一性约束，并通过自举训练扩大覆盖范围，成功为大量未标注能级完成分配，同时提出了非对称同位素体中AFGL符号向Herzberg符号转换的方法。

item.title: 面向机器学习辅助光谱偏振测量的非对称等离激元纳米结构偶极取向提取
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 P. Christian Simo, Michaela Zbytovska, Annika Mildner, Lukas Lang, Melanie Sommer, Dieter P. Kern 等7位作者
本文利用不同线性偏振片分析角下的偏振暗场光谱，对具有不同非对称性的纳米颗粒进行方位取向分析，并通过解析偶极模型拟合多组光谱以提取偶极取向。统计研究结合机器学习算法，所得偶极取向的方位分布与由模拟和电子显微镜图像得到的几何取向高度一致。研究还利用直方图梯度提升回归器评估测量设置对拟合结果的影响，从而提高偶极取向测量的准确性，并帮助机器学习模型解析纳米结构中的复杂特征。

item.description:

item.title: Benchmarking Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials for Dynamical Stability in Inorganic Semiconductor Nanocrystals: A CdSe Case Study
item.description:

arXiv:2609.15299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable nanosecond-scale atomistic simulations of inorganic semiconductor nanocrystals, but low errors on held-out configurations do not necessarily guarantee stable molecular dynamics. We benchmark five graph-neural-network MLIPs, SchNet, PaiNN, NequIP, Allegro and MACE, for dynamical stability in a chloride-passivated cadmium selenide nanocluster containing 149 atoms. The models were trained under harmonized conditions on 1,000 configurations and evaluated against 2,000 held-out configurations generated using density functional theory, considering force accuracy, computational efficiency, uncertainty and structural stability during 1 ns simulations at 300 K. Allegro produced the lowest validat…

item.title: Multi4D：用于复杂材料界面结构确定的端到端神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Haoran Zhang, Zian Mao, Shufen Chu, Xiaoya He, Yuyan Guan, Antong Yang 等9位作者
异质界面决定着功能材料的性能与退化过程，但结构异质性、物相重叠和局域无序会使衍射信号高度复杂。本文提出物理信息神经网络框架Multi4D，结合物理约束的扩散变换器和旋转不变卷积神经网络，实现基于4D-STEM的自动多组分晶体学识别。该方法能够以98.82%的准确率生成确定性的晶体学图谱，并通过分类器预测不确定性构建衍射推断结构复杂度指标，应用于多类复杂界面，实现单纳米级结构解析。

item.title: Thermal Hall effect in elemental niobium, a two-gap superconductor
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jing Zhang, Xiaokang Li, Kamran Behnia, Zengwei Zhu
研究通过热霍尔效应证明元素铌存在两能隙超导。冷却时横向热输运主导载流子发生符号转换，揭示此前难以分辨的小能隙。

item.title: 借助神经网络波函数迈向可预测的氢化物键能
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Aqsa Shaikh, Lubos Mitas, P. Ganesh, Jaron T. Krogel
由于强电子相关、相对论效应和核量子效应，过渡金属氢化物的键解离能仍难以准确预测。本文评估了基于Psiformer假设的神经网络变分蒙特卡罗方法在LiH、OH、TiH和NiH上的表现，并与CCSDT(Q)/CBS及已有理论和实验数据进行比较。结果表明，该方法可为主族和早期过渡金属氢化物提供具有竞争力的定量预测，而NiH则显示出晚期过渡金属氢化物仍是检验神经网络波函数表达能力的重要基准。

item.title: 广义标准材料框架内的数据驱动内聚区建模
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sida Hao, Jinkyo Han, Bahador Bahmani
内聚区模型广泛用于描述断裂和界面失效，但传统模型通常依赖针对具体问题设定的解析牵引—分离关系以及现象学卸载和再加载规则。本文在广义标准材料框架内提出统一的可学习内聚模型，在保持热力学结构固定的同时学习本构函数。通过输入凸神经网络表示主动表面自由能、用单调神经网络表示损伤抗力的倒数，并将凸性、单调性和损伤不可逆性直接纳入本构表示，该方法能够描述多种复杂的内聚响应。

item.title: 用于腹主动脉瘤动力学研究的物理信息神经网络模型
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Adrián Robles Arques, Martín Ruiz Fernandez, Javier Sanchis, Miguel A. Teruel, Juan Trujillo
本文建立并应用了一个三维物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于研究人体主动脉中的血流动力学行为。模型对两分钟时间范围内的脉动血流进行时变模拟，并提取具有高时间分辨率的压力场和速度场，再依据拉普拉斯定律计算主动脉壁机械应力。结果表明，PINN在保持物理一致性的同时，可作为复杂血管流动建模中相较传统CFD更高效且准确的替代方法。

item.title: 自旋电子储备池计算的编程
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yuichiro Terasaki, Yusuke Imai, Jason Z. Kim, Kohei Nakajima
本文提出一种自旋电子储备池计算机的编程框架，可将预先规定的输入-输出关系直接映射到读出层，从而绕过传统的数据驱动黑箱方法。该框架基于磁阻随机存取存储器，并利用磁化动力学执行计算；研究还引入了量化系统可编程性的通用指标，并利用方程的显式参数依赖构造可外部控制的读出层。示例涵盖神经网络仿真、分岔嵌入和五次代数方程的牛顿求解器，同时证明了无限系统规模和输入持续时间极限下的通用逼近性质。

item.title: HiGFRL: Hierarchical Graph Fusion-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Dependency-Aware Task Scheduling in Heterogeneous Cloud
item.description:
📚 arXiv

HiGFRL面向异构云中依赖任务在线调度。三层图状态与融合式强化学习联合建模DAG拓扑和资源动态，在阿里集群轨迹上优于启发式和DRL基线。

item.description:

VPAC用自助法和随机缩放替代方差评论家。该单评论家风险敏感RL框架具有收敛分析，并在随机环境及超导制造案例中降低波动。

item.title: 利用深度学习预测恒星条件下等离子体的不透明度
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Djamel Benredjem, Jean-Christophe Pain
本文旨在预测恒星条件下等离子体的不透明度，重点研究铁和镍。作者构建并训练了卷积神经网络与多层感知器相结合的混合模型，用于预测0至10000 eV能量范围内的光谱不透明度及相应的平均不透明度。结果与标准计算方法总体符合良好，同时显著降低了计算成本；但在高温镍等离子体的L壳层和M壳层能区，由于大量跃迁产生，仍存在较大偏差。

item.title: A Machine Learning API for Earth Observation Data Cubes Based on openEO

BudgetBench将单次调用输入token预算作为评估记忆策略的自变量。该协议和工具暴露预算违规、非单调质量曲线及单预算评估隐藏的运行点。

item.description:

研究评估预测密度、哈密顿量和密度矩阵作为周期DFT自洽场初值的效果。结果表明离线误差低不等于闭环加速好，必须在SCF循环中检验。

item.title: Unbiased first-principles construction of complete tensorial spin Hamiltonians
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Haichang Lu, Boyang Deng, Hiroshi Katsumoto, John Robertson, Weisheng Zhao, Stefan Blügel
arXiv:2609.13912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic ground states are commonly predicted using spin Hamiltonians whose interaction terms are selected a priori, potentially overlooking the microscopic interactions that govern complex magnetic order. Here, we introduce a general framework for the unbiased first-principles construction of symmetry-complete tensorial spin Hamiltonians and its automated implementation in AMATIS. The framework constructs the Hamiltonian directly from density-functional theory while rigorously enforcing quantum spin algebra and crystallographic symmetry. Applied to representative two-dimensional van der Waals magnets, the framework reproduces established magnetic interactions and uncovers hidden physics beyond conventional spin models, including chiral inte…

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Proximity-induced charge density waves in a moiré heterobilayer
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Christopher T. S. Cheung, Arash A. Mostofi, Johannes Lischner
arXiv:2609.15775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted heterobilayers of two-dimensional materials have emerged as a platform for studying emergent phases of matter. In this work, we investigate charge density waves (CDW) in a twisted NbSe₂/MoSe₂ bilayer using first-principles calculations. We observe CDW formation in both layers, even though MoSe₂ does not feature a CDW in its monolayer form. Moreover, we find that the CDW is highly non-uniform with filled-center, hollow-center and hexagonal CDWs coexisting in the moiré unit cells of both layers. We assess different mechanisms of CDW formation in the MoSe₂ layer and conclude that the dominant one is the steric repulsion between Se atoms across the van der Waals gap. The strength of this effect is highly sensitive to the interlayer separ…

item.title: Probing the anomalous symmetry-breaking in kagome material CsV3Sb5 via third-order nonlinearity
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zheng Dai, Fengyi Guo, Shuai Zhang, Xiubing Li, Congcong Li, Yufan Ju 等10位作者

item.title: 跨越BCS-BEC交叉区的交错磁性
item.description:
